Browser extra_wait adds additional time after network_idle to ensure all async operations complete

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"browser\":{\"extra_wait\":200,\"mode\":\"always\",\"wait\":\"network_idle\"}}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.browserUsed())
```
